text: This report recommends approval of travel expenses for two staff, Stirling Bogey, Senior Event and Meeting Coordinator and Mike Carstenson, Facility Coordinator to attend the first year and the second year respectively of the International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM), Venue Management School (VMS).

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized travel expenses for Mike Carstensen, Facility Coordinator, and Stirling Bogie, Senior Event and Meeting Coordinator to attend the International Association of Venue Managers School in Palm Springs, California from June 7 to June 12, 2025, at a cost not expected to exceed $6,500 each plus HST for flights, accommodation, and incidental expenses per registrant.
